# PoiTagFilter Interface

> [!CAUTION]
> This interface is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

Selects block point-of-interest types that have all specified tags.

## Properties

### **tags**
`tags: string[];`

Namespaced POI tags that a matching type must contain. All tags in the array are required.

Type: *string*[]
